required_segments.notes: ISA06 (Sender ID) must be your assigned RetailerA supplier ID, padded to 15 chars.
GS01 must be 'SH' for Ship Notice.
BSN02 is the supplier-assigned ASN reference number. Must be unique per shipment.
DTM*011 is the actual ship date. Format: YYYYMMDD. Must appear at HL shipment level.
DTM*063 is the committed ship-by date from the purchase order. REQUIRED — omission triggers chargeback CB-0042.
REF*BM is the bill of lading number. Required at shipment HL level.
REF*PO ties the ASN back to the originating purchase order. Required at order HL level.
HL03='S' for Shipment. Top-level hierarchy node.
HL03='O' for Order. Child of Shipment HL.
HL03='P' for Pack/Carton. Child of Order HL.
TD101 is the packaging code (e.g. CTN25). TD106 weight qualifier must be 'G' (gross).
TD502 must be the SCAC code of the carrier. TD503 is the carrier routing code.
SE01 segment count must exactly match number of segments including ST and SE.

known_issues.title: Missing Ship-By Date
known_issues.description: DTM*063 (Ship-By Date) absent from shipment-level HL loop.
known_issues.root_cause_pattern: Supplier ERP does not expose a 'commit ship date' field in their EDI mapping for this order type.
known_issues.recommended_fix: Map PO line-level scheduled ship date to DTM*063 in the HL Shipment loop.

known_issues.title: Invalid REF Qualifier
known_issues.description: REF qualifier not in approved whitelist. Common offenders: ZZ, DP, L1.
known_issues.root_cause_pattern: Supplier sends a generic REF*ZZ when no approved qualifier maps to their internal reference type.
known_issues.recommended_fix: Use REF*BM for bill of lading. Contact RetailerA EDI team if you need a custom qualifier approved.

known_issues.title: ASN Sent After Ship
known_issues.description: ASN transmission timestamp (ISA09/ISA10) is more than 2 hours after BSN03 (ship date/time).
known_issues.root_cause_pattern: Manual ASN submission process introduces delay; should be automated at pick/pack confirmation.
known_issues.recommended_fix: Trigger ASN generation automatically when warehouse system confirms shipment departure.
